content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi). It is a prestigious government institution known for its academic excellence and research.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow. This position is typically involved in research projects within the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in this recruitment drive. Candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications via email for the Junior Research Fellow post is 24 August 2026. Applicants are advised to apply well in advance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application and documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Post Graduate Degree in Mathematics/ Statistics/ Data Science/ Computer Science or a related discipline, and be NET or GATE qualified in a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow post is Rs 37,000/- per month, along with HRA @27%. This is a competitive salary for research positions.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without any cost.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position includes short-listing of applications followed by an online interview. Candidates will be informed about the interview schedule.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow post will be New Delhi, Delhi, specifically at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi campus.
